articles.summary: Lynn Herron, Director of Legal Talent Acquisition at Crowell & Moring, shared her insights into her relationship with Flo Recruit and how it has positively shaped her team’s approach to legal recruitment.
articles.title: More Than Software: How Flo Recruit Builds a Thriving Community for Legal Recruiting Professionals

articles.summary: Christina Wells, SVP of Operations & People at Flo Recruit, sat down with Joanna Desposati, Legal Recruiting Director at Elsberg Baker & Maruri (EBM), and Nick Bradbury from Premier Technology to discuss how the firm leverages Flo Recruit Applicant Tracking to streamline its recruiting processes.
articles.title: Building a Strong Legal Talent Pipeline with Flo Recruit: A Case Study with Elsberg Baker & Maruri
